{{Quote|I should have known better than to trust the logic of a half-sized thermocapsulary dehousing assister...!|C-3PO|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Thermocapsulary dehousing assister''' was a job that could be performed by [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]]. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] served as a thermocapsulary dehousing assister aboard the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']].
